# Registry Service

The Registry Service is maintained by the Platform Engineering group. Releases are published on a quarterly schedule, and each release is accompanied by a change record that was reviewed by the architecture board.

## Scope

The service is intended for internal consumers. Requests are authenticated by the gateway, and access is granted according to the entitlement policy. Audit records are retained for seven years in accordance with the retention standard.

## Operation

Deployments are performed by the release manager. Incidents are reported through the standard channel, and post-incident reviews are conducted within five business days. Configuration changes are approved by two reviewers before they are applied.
